tolerance.note: every recorded row bitwise (PLAN §5.1 chaos class: the first 600 steps must be bitwise; these runs stay bitwise throughout); events / fx / ocean calls identical

ocean.wavebank: setQuality(8, 300); setSeed(303, 0.6); every frame BEFORE the heli: update(dt, t, sea, 0.6, 1, 0, 0)

weather.windAt: base + amp·(sin(0.3t + 0.002x), cos(0.21t + 0.002z)), t = game time this frame

setup.frame: pokes; dt = paused ? 0 : realDt·timeScale; t += dt; world/survivors/hazards advance(dt); weather state; bank.update; input; heli.update(dt); rig.update(realDt)

data.inputConstNote: input fields equal on every frame (not in the sidecar)
data.visualsNote: visual-state rows (rotor, hull, veil, searchlight, lights, crewman, winch render) every 30th frame
data.cableNote: per `states` row: winch cur (15 × xyz) then rend (15 × xyz)
data.ringNote: every 30th frame: reach-ring vertex positions (49 × 2 × xyz)
data.glintsNote: every 12th frame: [frame, index in that frame, gx, gz, radius, intensity] per ocean.addGlint call
